actions.text:
WITH purchase_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    u.country,
    SUM(p.total_amount) as total_purchases
  FROM users u
  JOIN purchases p ON u.user_id = p.user_id
  GROUP BY u.country
),
refund_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    u.country,
    SUM(r.refund_amount) as total_refunds
  FROM users u
  JOIN purchases p ON u.user_id = p.user_id
  JOIN refunds r ON p.purchase_id = r.purchase_id
  GROUP BY u.country
)
SELECT 
  pt.country,
  pt.total_purchases - COALESCE(rt.total_refunds, 0) as net_revenue
FROM purchase_totals pt
LEFT JOIN refund_totals rt ON pt.country = rt.country
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH ordered_amounts AS (
  SELECT 
    total_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount) AS row_num,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
  FROM purchases
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) as median
FROM ordered_amounts
WHERE row_num >= FLOOR((total_count + 1) / 2.0)
  AND row_num <= CEIL((total_count + 1) / 2.0)
